verses.text: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

verses.text: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

verses.text: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
